question: Are the previously reported 857 overlapping greedy T0/T1 clock-cut locations *forced* in all minimum-cut segmentations, or can equally optimal partitions move breaks? How does this change across DST/clock interpretation worlds?

worlds.time: date-only any second 00:00:00..23:59:59; naive local clock
date-only full local day converted by America/Denver, true IANA folds as intervals
date-only 00:00:00..01:00:00 under America/Denver, preserve disjoint UTC second-fold

negative_control: Fixed MST UTC-07 produces precisely identical segmentation and optimal-cut classes to NAIVE for the same T0/T1.

model.record_order: prior T0 lower time, upper time, original DBF ordinal per Herd,AID,SeasnYr,Season
model.block_feasible: one shared temporal assignment for all records of the contiguous block, exact union-of-interval second-resolution propagation
model.DAG: one boundary node for each cut position 0..N. Directed edge i→j for i<j iff fixes i..j-1 form a feasible block. Every 0→N path is a valid contiguous partition.
model.optimum: fewest number of segments (all singleton blocks permitted), minimum path length from boundary 0 to N.
model.optimal_edge_condition: DAG block edge i→j lies on at least one minimum-segment path iff dist_from_start[i]+1+dist_to_end[j]==dist_from_start[N].

link_types.forced_cut: source link at boundary k is cut in every minimum-segment path (no on-optimal DAG block edge spans k)
link_types.optional: there is at least one optimal path visiting boundary k (cut) AND at least one optimal DAG edge spanning boundary k (retain)
link_types.forced_retain: source link at boundary k is retained in every minimum-segment path (boundary k does not lie on any minimum-segment path)

model.must_check: Exactly one class for each of 28,532 source links under each world; any greedy selected cut MUST be forced_cut or optional; a forced_retain link cannot be in a valid greedy partition.

metrics: per world: N links, min cuts, forced_cut/optional/forced_retain counts, greedy cuts intersecting forced_cut vs optional, groups with nonunique optimal cut masks
across four worlds: links forced_cut in ALL four, links forced_retain in ALL four, links not universally fixed either way, links optional in at least one world
pairwise four-world forced-cut vs greedy selected mask overlap; no derived biological prediction scores
per-world optimal partitions count capped after 1,000,000 (report at least two, not huge exact count)
brute-force oracle of all 2^(n-1) contiguous partitions for at least 250 random 2-6 fix integer interval-union worlds, validating optimal count and all forced/optional status classes
holdout/author CRS and clock semantics unresolved flags
stop: Fail on SHA/count change, unexpected timezone or nonfinite timestamps, mismatch to previous 857/858/889/890 greedy controls
Never call a greedy common cut a biologically mandated disconnection
Never equate time-gap link reachability to ecological movement route or Brownian bridge output
Do not open 2h, use outcomes, or promote a fourth EOG-WF endpoint
No raw timestamps, individual identities, per-fix/link positions or coordinates written to the repository
